subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: suddenly stops moving completely, the smile frozen, the large black eyes fixed on the camera without blinking; the head leans a little closer toward the camera very slowly and stays there, perfectly still, only the laced fingers twitch once; then he leans back into the starting pose and smiles as if nothing happened The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
